svg.title: Proa, Marko, React and SvelteKit streaming the product grid under HTTP load

svg.text: 96 cards · 8 boundaries · one worker/process per engine · two separate captures
Higher is better · dashed: request-rate target
HTTP response end: resolved HTML for Proa; promised data for SvelteKit streaming.
Sum of 3 full phases, including drain
Latency includes scheduled-arrival queueing. More failures can reduce the successful-response P95.
Data response end excludes browser rendering. Complete-DOM timings: sveltekit/browser.svg.
